rationale: I consume butyrate and acetate via β-oxidation, paired with amino acid catabolism (arginine, cysteine, serine) for nitrogen and additional carbon. Inositol provides fermentable hexose. Fermentation yields butyrate, acetate, and CO₂ as end products. Carbon balance: 57.4 in − 35.4 products = 22 mmol C for biomass at 38 mmol C/g = 0.58 /h; conservatively report 0.50 /h. Nitrogen: 6.8 mmol N in supports this growth rate.
